faq3.title: Frequently asked questions
faq3.description: Practical answers about projects, working together, and ongoing website support.

items.q: What kinds of projects do you take on?
items.a: I work on custom websites, web applications, branding, advertisements, social graphics, and other visual assets. I also support and improve existing websites.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside Rhode Island?
items.a: Yes. Volatile Solutions serves Rhode Island and remote clients. We can discuss your goals and project needs remotely.

items.q: Can you improve a website I already have?
items.a: Yes. Website Support & Optimization includes updates, troubleshooting, and refinements to an existing site. I start by reviewing what you have and what you want to improve.

items.q: What happens after I reach out?
items.a: Share a brief overview of your project or opportunity and any relevant links. We can discuss your goals, review the scope, and identify sensible next steps.
